# VisioForge SDK - Professional Video & Media Processing for .NET

> VisioForge provides enterprise-grade .NET SDKs for comprehensive video/audio processing, built on proven native libraries (FFmpeg, GStreamer) with managed wrappers. Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

**Generated:** 2026-11-27 20:41:07 UTC (c5e129a2023)

## MCP Server (for AI coding agents)

> Before reading the full text, call the VisioForge MCP server at **https://mcp.visioforge.com/mcp** for structured API lookups, code examples, and deployment guides. Public endpoint, no authentication required. 14 tools: `search_api`, `list_sdk_classes`, `get_class_info`, `get_method_signature`, `get_code_example`, `get_nuget_packages_snippet`, `list_deployment_guides`, `get_deployment_guide`, `get_platform_specific_config`, `get_enum_values`, `list_namespaces`, `get_pipeline_template`, `list_media_blocks`, `get_media_block_info` (the last three are the Media Blocks catalog).

- **Endpoint**: `https://mcp.visioforge.com/mcp`
- **Documentation**: [MCP server usage guide](https://www.visioforge.com/help/docs/dotnet/general/mcp-server-usage/)
- **Claude Code**: `claude mcp add --transport http visioforge-sdk https://mcp.visioforge.com/mcp`
- **Cursor / Windsurf / other MCP clients**: add the endpoint to the MCP config (HTTP transport, no auth).

The MCP server returns surgical answers (single API class, single code example); the full-text files under ## Full text carry every help and website page. Prefer MCP for code generation; use the full text for broad context / discovery.

## Products

- [Video Capture SDK .NET](https://www.visioforge.com/video-capture-sdk-net): Record webcams, IP cameras (RTSP/ONVIF), screens, and USB devices to MP4/AVI. C# / VB.NET SDK for Unity, WPF, MAUI, Avalonia. Free 30-day trial.
- [Media Player SDK .NET](https://www.visioforge.com/media-player-sdk-net): Video player SDK for C# / .NET: H.264, HEVC, AV1, RTSP, HLS, DASH with GPU decoding. MAUI, Avalonia and Unity apps on Windows, macOS, Android and iOS.
- [Video Edit SDK .NET](https://www.visioforge.com/video-edit-sdk-net): C# video editor library for .NET: cut and merge clips on a timeline, add transitions, titles and effects, export MP4 with GPU encoding. Cross-platform.
- [Media Blocks SDK .NET](https://www.visioforge.com/media-blocks-sdk-net): Build C#/.NET media pipelines with 200+ blocks, AI OCR/ANPR, object analytics, Whisper captions, Unity, and GPU acceleration.
- [Video Edit SDK FFmpeg .NET](https://www.visioforge.com/video-edit-sdk-ffmpeg-net): Use FFmpeg from C# without building command lines: transcode to MP4, MKV, WebM or MOV, cut and join clips, NVENC/QSV encoding. Windows. Free trial.
- [Virtual Camera SDK](https://www.visioforge.com/virtual-camera-sdk): Add a virtual webcam and microphone to your Windows app. Zoom, OBS and browser apps see them as real devices. C#, C++ and Delphi. Free trial.
- [Video Encryption SDK](https://www.visioforge.com/video-encryption-sdk): Encrypt video/audio files with AES-256 and custom keys in C# / .NET. DRM-level protection for distributed and on-device content. Free 30-day trial.
- [Video Fingerprinting SDK](https://www.visioforge.com/video-fingerprinting-sdk): On-premise video fingerprinting SDK. Detect duplicates, piracy, and content matches in live streams. .NET for Windows/macOS/Linux, C++ for Windows/Linux.
- [All-in-One Media Framework](https://www.visioforge.com/all-in-one-media-framework): Video capture, editing, playback, and streaming for Delphi and ActiveX in one bundle. VCL components + ActiveX controls. RAD Studio, VB6, C++ Builder.
- [Encoding Filters Pack](https://www.visioforge.com/encoding-filters-pack): Commercial DirectShow encoding filters: H.264, HEVC, VP9, AAC, MP3. NVENC/QSV/AMF GPU acceleration. Drop-in for any DirectShow app.
- [FFmpeg Source DirectShow Filter](https://www.visioforge.com/ffmpeg-source-directshow-filter): Professional FFmpeg-based DirectShow source filter. Play MP4, HEVC, VP9, ProRes with NVIDIA/Intel/AMD GPU decoding. HLS, SRT streams supported.
- [Processing Filters Pack](https://www.visioforge.com/processing-filters-pack): Commercial DirectShow processing filters: video effects, color correction, audio normalization, chroma key, motion detection. Drop-in for .NET apps.
- [VLC Source DirectShow Filter](https://www.visioforge.com/vlc-source-directshow-filter): Use VLC engine as a DirectShow source filter. Play network streams, tricky codecs, and niche formats in any DirectShow app via VLC's proven decoders.
- [Video Piracy Detection](https://www.visioforge.com/detecting-pirated-video-content): Automatically flag pirated video uploads on your platform. Fingerprint-based matching against your reference library. On-premise, real-time. Free demo.
- [GStreamer Metal Plugin](https://www.visioforge.com/gstreamer-metal): Open-source GStreamer plugin replacing CPU-bound video elements with Metal GPU on macOS and iOS. 15 effects, zero-copy single-pass. LGPL v2 on GitHub.
- [Unity Video SDK](https://www.visioforge.com/unity-video-sdk): Play, capture, stream, and edit video in Unity 6 with VisioForge .NET SDKs. RTSP, webcams, MP4 — into a Unity texture. Windows, Android, macOS, iOS.

Media Blocks SDK .NET is the composition layer under the Video Capture, Media Player and Video Edit SDKs: choose it for custom source-to-encoder pipelines, not for ordinary capture, playback or editing.

### Support

| Service | Price | Billing |
|---------|-------|---------|
| Priority Support | €750 | per year |
| Engineering Hours, 2 hours | €150 | one-time |
| Engineering Hours, 5 hours | €375 | one-time |
| Engineering Hours, 10 hours | €700 | one-time |
| Engineering Hours, 25 hours | €1500 | one-time |

- **Priority Support** is a yearly subscription: a private channel, a first answer within 1 business day on every question, and 5 engineering hours a year for integration help, custom code and samples, in writing, over AnyDesk or in a Teams or Telegram call, by appointment, with time rounded up to the next 15-minute step. On renewal up to 5 unused hours carry over once into the next year; carried-over hours are used first, and any still unused at the end of that year lapse. Extra hours are bought as Engineering Hours packs.
- **Engineering Hours** cover integration help, custom code and samples for your project at €75 per hour; larger packs are discounted. Purchased hours do not expire. Sessions take place by appointment, Monday to Friday, 9:00–18:00 CET/CEST. Time is rounded up to the next 15-minute step.
- Diagnosing a defect of the SDK itself is free and never consumes hours, purchased or included.
- Every license includes e-mail support; see [www.visioforge.com/licensing](https://www.visioforge.com/licensing).

### Notes

- All paid licenses include **royalty-free distribution**: you may incorporate the SDK into your own commercial applications and distribute those applications without royalty payments; end users of your applications are not required to purchase separate licenses; applications built with the evaluation version may not be distributed
- **Developer licenses** are assigned to **one named developer** and include minor and major updates plus email support for 12 months; automatic renewal can be cancelled anytime
- **Workgroup licenses** cover three named developers in one organization at the price of two Developer licenses; updates, support and renewal work as for the Developer license
- **Lifetime·Team licenses** cover all developers in the purchasing organization at one location in one city and include perpetual use, lifetime minor and major updates, and email support
- After an Annual subscription ends, the last SDK version covered by the subscription continues to function, but newer updates are not available
- **Source code** of the main .NET SDKs (Video Capture, Media Player, Video Edit, Video Edit FFmpeg, Media Blocks) and of the All-in-One Media Framework (Delphi, ActiveX) is licensed separately from €10,000, quoted on request. The other products list their source price in the tables above; those listed source licenses are one-time for one company, include the Lifetime·Team license and 1 year of source updates (then 30% a year), and cover VisioForge code only. Every source license, listed or quoted, keeps the source itself inside the buyer's company; builds of it ship only inside the buyer's own applications, never as a standalone filter, SDK or component for other developers
- A free community license (one developer, no revenue: open-source, free apps, education, research, non-profit; the SDK keeps the trial watermark and adds the VisioForge logo) can be requested at [www.visioforge.com/community-license](https://www.visioforge.com/community-license)
- All prices are in **Euros (€)**
- Any product can be purchased on the product page at [www.visioforge.com](https://www.visioforge.com)

## Guides

- [RTSP Stream Viewer and IP Camera Player in C# .NET](https://www.visioforge.com/help/docs/dotnet/mediablocks/Guides/rtsp-player-csharp/): Build an RTSP stream viewer and IP camera player in C# with VisioForge Media Blocks SDK — live preview, ONVIF discovery, and passthrough recording.
- [IP Camera Integration in C# .NET — RTSP/ONVIF Guides](https://www.visioforge.com/help/docs/dotnet/videocapture/video-sources/ip-cameras/): Connect IP cameras over RTSP and ONVIF in C# / .NET. Authentication, multi-stream, discovery, reconnect. Complete samples for all major brands.
- [Record Webcam to MP4 in C# WPF with H.264 and AAC Audio](https://www.visioforge.com/help/docs/dotnet/videocapture/video-tutorials/video-capture-webcam-mp4-wpf/): Build a WPF window in XAML that previews a webcam and records it to MP4 with GPU H.264 and AAC, using VisioForge Video Capture SDK. C# code and video.
